modalities.evidence: a standard T1w image was acquired for each subject
each subject underwent an fMRI scan with blocs of CO2 inhalation challenges
breath CO2 was recorded using a capnograph

output.population: Human; Healthy / Control; ages 21–67; fifty healthy adult subjects with no prior history of neurological or psychiatric disorder
output.summary: Normative dataset for cerebrovascular reactivity mapping in healthy adults: T1-weighted anatomy, fMRI with CO2 inhalation challenges, and capnograph breath CO2, plus fMRIPrep and CVRmap derivatives.
